compared.method: Compared every retained national/body meeting array with direct source/fact packages, matching primary and merged IDs. Historical reads include canonical promoted source versions. Coverage checks use the current canonical registry and local registration divisions.

corrections.problem: The direct query omitted state-family calendars.
corrections.cause: Canonical family scopes contain US-AZ, US-NH and US-NJ; the query omitted the US- prefix.
corrections.result: All currently shown IDs and venue details are retained.

corrections.problem: Three older calendar records were absent from current partitions and durable history.
corrections.cause: Existing history movement excludes calendar-only rows without agendas or outcomes.
corrections.result: Explicit history reads recover verified records from prior PROMOTED canonical source versions, without reading prepared copies.

corrections.problem: 68 independently sourced bodies were absent from the reviewed registry.
corrections.result: Their published calendar body name and provenance reach the existing coverage-card model. Live body-name facts retain precedence. Derived metadata uses the DERIVED dataset label.

bodyWithoutHeldServiceBoundary.result: The direct package retains its body and meetings. It is not assigned to a ZIP body card without a held service division or territory; it was also absent from the saved old 85701 body-card response.

reasons.reason: Pima Legistar source links changed to current canonical meeting-detail URLs; old links remain in field receipts.
Vail Apptegy uses the same official endpoint with a newer rolling start_date parameter and source-check date.
